items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: "In this respect, a band made up of some of the New York guys like Wild Bill. I like Wild Bill. He doesn't play a real classic New Orleans style. But he plays hot and he does this backing up and stuff. And some of the things he made with Cindy Bichet were just wonderful."

ctx.x: Well, what about... Do you think that your band has had any effect on the Minneapolis listening public?

Oh, absolutely. We've gained a following, you know. And now there's two separate schools. There's Doc Evans School and the Hall Brothers School for listening to music. We've been able to convert a lot of people, not because of musicianship, because we're pretty sure on that, actually. In that respect, I think we kind of resemble the bands down here. We've learned just enough music to do what we want to do. And they haven't gone into any really... gone into the pursuit of the instrument very deeply. But just to…
